people.imagined: Dawn on the Fire Court's terrace. She stands still in the pale-gold robe with her head tilted, listening to something behind the room; the first light touches the robe and it glows faintly, which embarrasses her, and she turns her eyes to the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: at first light on a terrace of red stone, she holds her head tilted sharply to the right, ear toward the shoulder, as if listening to a sound behind the room, then glances at the viewer, a little embarrassed. Face: a slight, thin young face of about twenty-eight with quick, bright, market-girl eyes of light amber, a small sharp chin, a small straight nose, a quick half smile, sun-warmed skin. Hair: black, in a high knot held by a small red-lacquer hairpin and one short red feather behind the ear, a few fine strands drifting. Clothing: layered silk in pale dawn-gold, three crossed collars of cream, gold and soft vermilion, wide sleeves that fall in long folds, a narrow gold phoenix-feather border at the hem and cuffs, a vermilion sash hung with a small red jade pendant; the gold silk glows faintly where the dawn touches it, which she finds embarrassing. Hands and objects: a plain pale bamboo flute worn smooth at the finger holes, held in both hands before her chest; a folding fan of red feathers tucked in the sash. Power: a faint white-gold shimmer around her shoulders, a few motes of light and tiny drifting sparks of flame, only a hint. Background: a blurred terrace of red stone, rosy mist and a pink-gold sky. Light: soft gold dawn from the upper left, a gentle glowing rim light along her sleeve. Expression: trusting, attentive, a little shy.

people.imagined: Late at night in the Nest, a brush drying in his hand. He has written another letter he will not show anyone, and he glances up as the door opens, covering the page with a fan painted with yellow chrysanthemums.
people.subject: The moment: at a low desk late at night, he quickly covers a written page with an open fan and looks up at the viewer with a restless, caught look, half a laugh at himself. Face: a long, lean, angular face, high forehead, strong nose, quick dark eyes, a lopsided smile, faint stubble, shadowed eyes from a sleepless week, a pale ink thumbprint on the jaw. Hair: black, tied in a high knot with a red cord and a slim gold pin, one long lock falling free. Clothing: flowing vermilion silk in three layers, crossed collars of cream and flame-orange, wide sleeves ink-stained at the cuffs, a golden chrysanthemum embroidered over the heart among the phoenix-flame borders, a gold-edged red sash hung with a jade tassel; no leather. Hands and objects: an open fan painted with large yellow chrysanthemums in the right hand; a brush with a drop of ink on its tip in the left; a lacquered desk with an inkstone, blank sheets under a jade weight and a cold tea bowl. Power: a few small red sparks drift up from the fan's edge, a warm ember-coloured haze at his shoulders. Background: a dark chamber with one lamp, blurred bookshelves and soft drifting mist. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left with a faint spirit-glow rim. Expression: brave, restless, secretive.

people.imagined: The vein fort at dusk, a letter half written, a candle by it. She has burned two drafts already; her hand goes to the hairpin her mother wore, and she looks up with a calm that costs her something.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk at dusk, she touches her hairpin with one hand and looks up at the viewer calmly, a half-written letter before her, the calm costing her something. Face: a broad, calm, gentle face of about forty, wide-set grey-brown eyes, a firm jaw, a soft full mouth, a faint line between the brows, her father's build and her mother's stillness. Hair: black, in a low coil held by an old, worn, red-lacquered wooden hairpin carved with a small flame, polished smooth by years of wear, with one small gold phoenix pin beside it. Clothing: a well-cut vermilion silk robe in layers, crossed collars of cream and red, wide sleeves, borders of gold flame and white feather thread, a dark-red sash with a red jade pendant; broad-shouldered, tall, sitting upright. Hands and objects: a folded fan of red silk on the desk; her left hand flat on a sheet of paper; a small candle beside it and two blackened scraps of burned paper in a dish. Power: a thin warm orange glow lies about her shoulders and green motes of leaf-light drift near the candle, soft and steady. Background: a blurred stone wall with a narrow window onto a dusk sky, the red-brown slope of the vein and a patrol on the wall small as pins, mist in the valley. Light: a single candle from the lower left in warm gold, cool blue dusk behind, a faint rim light on her hair. Expression: peaceable, steady, grieving.

people.imagined: Before dawn at the outer gate, a row of nervous children kneeling. He has lifted the flute to his lips, bent and smiling, and the first note is about to decide who passes. His stonemason's thumb is on the first hole.
people.subject: The moment: bent forward in the blue hour before dawn, he raises a flute to his lips, smiling, about to blow the first note that will decide who passes; his thumb is on the first hole. Face: a bent, deeply lined, smiling old face of about seventy, cheeks creased like folded cloth, soft white brows, a thin white beard, small kind bright dark eyes half-lidded, a few small yellowed teeth, a white tuft in each ear, a fine blue vein at the temple, a faint teasing patience. Hair: thin white, tied in a small knot with a red cord and a plain gold pin. Clothing: layered vermilion silk faded to soft orange at the elbows, clean and neatly mended, crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves, borders of gold and green feather thread, a dark-red sash with a small red jade; the richer robe of a steward and elder. Hands and objects: a bamboo flute worn pale and glossy along the finger stops, held in broad, thick stonemason's hands with square knuckles; he is small, bent in the back, round-shouldered. Power: a soft red-gold warmth about the flute and faint green motes drifting from its mouth, the gentle aura of an old cultivator. Background: a blurred gate courtyard in pre-dawn blue mist with a row of small children kneeling in plain hemp on cold stone, their faces pale, a red lacquered gate half open and one lit lantern. Light: a thin pink band of dawn from the upper left touching the flute and his white hair, a glowing rim light. Expression: a crinkled, kind smile with half-lidded bright eyes and teasing patience that gives away nothing.

people.imagined: Night in the Wutong Court, the aviary hushed. She has just come from the great tree, hands still warm from something she has not told anyone; a blue-backed kingfisher sits on her collar, unmoving.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a hushed aviary at night, she looks quietly toward the viewer with a thumb-sized blue-backed kingfisher perched unmoving on her collar. Face: a quiet, composed, oval face of about forty-five, smooth olive skin, calm hazel eyes, a small closed mouth, lowered lashes, a hint of weariness, her glance aside as if keeping something back. Hair: black, in a low knot with a green silk ribbon and a single jade wutong-leaf hairpin. Clothing: flowing layers of deep leaf-green silk over a vermilion inner robe showing at the cuffs, crossed collars of green, cream and flame, wide sleeves, borders of gold and green feather embroidery, a darker green sash hung with a jade pendant, a plain wutong-twig ring on her right hand. Hands and objects: a small cloth bag of seed in her right hand for the kingfisher, her spirit bird, bright blue and white at her throat; a folding fan of green feathers. Power: soft green wisps of qi and tiny motes of leaf-light drift around her and the bird, with a faint warm red undertone. Background: dark wutong boughs in mist, the red-crested heads of sleeping birds, talon scratches on the perches and a basket of fallen green seeds. Light: dim green-gold spirit-light from the upper left, a soft glowing rim along her sleeve. Expression: still and private, a closed mouth and a sidelong look.

people.imagined: In an inn courtyard in the north, a letter in his hand, wine on the table. He is reading it aloud with a courteous smile to a companion just out of frame.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an inn courtyard table in the north, he holds a letter at arm's length and reads from it with a smooth courteous smile, his eyes lifting to the viewer. Face: a long, courteous, narrow face of about forty-five, high forehead, a finely trimmed pointed beard, a long nose, bright merry black eyes, a polite curve to the mouth that does not reach them, a faint smile line in each cheek, a small gold earring in his left ear. Hair: black, neat and oiled, in a high knot with a plain jade pin. Body: tall, long-limbed, easy, one leg crossed. Clothing: fine vermilion silk travelling robes in layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves bordered with gold flame and white feather thread, a short dark-red gauze cape over one shoulder, a red sash with a red jade pendant. Hands and objects: an unrolled letter in the clean right hand; a small cup of wine in the left; a pepper pod on the table. Power: a faint warm red-gold glow and a few drifting blue motes at his cuffs. Background: open shutters on a dark northern street, a wine jug, and at the far end of the table the blurred shoulder of a second man in a deep blue coat, hanging lanterns in mist. Light: warm low lantern light from the upper left that makes the clean fingers glow, a soft rim light. Expression: gregarious, courteous and not quite candid.

people.imagined: At night at the black-stone post at the Ash Seat's lip, practising the forbidden fan. She has stopped mid-stroke, caught by a footstep, and her sleeves are no longer perfect.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a black-stone post, she holds a red feather fan raised and level, mid-stroke, and stares down at the viewer unsmiling, caught by a footstep. Face: a tall, narrow, unsmiling face of about thirty-three, sharp straight nose, sharp cheekbones, pale freckled skin, hard amber eyes narrowed, pale lashes tipped in red-gold, a thin hard mouth, chin lifted. Hair: true vivid copper-flame red, long, in a high ponytail tied with a vermilion cord and a gold hairpin shaped like a feather, the loose end whipping. Clothing: immaculate vermilion silk in three layers, crossed collars of flame-orange and cream, wide trailing sleeves with gold phoenix-feather borders, a dark-red sash with a red jade pendant; at the cuff of her right sleeve a thin dark scorch edge has just begun. Hands and objects: a red feather fan held out in the right hand; behind her a tall post of black volcanic stone scored with a hundred pale slashes. Power: a strong aura of flame around her raised arm, red sparks and embers rising from her sleeve, the hem of her robe lifting in a hot updraft. Background: a dark night sky with drifting red sparks rising from the vent far below. Light: deep orange glow from below and the right on the underside of her chin and the length of the raised arm, cold small stars above, a hot rim light. Expression: a cold, unyielding stare, nostrils slightly flared.

people.imagined: At the Nest's vent in the evening, her sleeve pushed up. She is turning her scarred arm toward the heat and looks at the viewer with a stubborn jaw, deciding which side she is on.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the glowing lip of a vent at evening, she holds her bare forearm out toward the viewer with her jaw set, deciding which side she is on. Face: a short, broad, strong face of about thirty, skin mottled with old burn marks, shiny pink and white scar tissue rippling across her neck, cheek and arm, a flattened nose, thick dark brows, the eyebrow on the burnt side missing and the lid drooping a little, hard dark eyes, a firm square jaw. Hair: black, cropped very short and uneven, a few grey hairs at the temple where a scar has killed the colour. Body: short, thick-armed, broad, planted low with feet wide. Clothing: vermilion silk robes in layers, the right sleeve of gauze pushed up to the shoulder, collars open at the neck in gold and flame-orange, a gold-bordered dark-red sash with red jade, small gold phoenix-feather embroidery at the hem. Hands and objects: her right forearm held out, shining with an old burn that runs down to the bone line; a short red fan in the left hand. Power: a strong steady red-orange aura of flame clings to her arm and shoulders, embers rising from the scars like drifting stars. Background: a lip of black rock curves round a glowing orange crack in the ground under red haze, above it a pavilion with a single red lantern. Light: violet dusk, and the vent's deep orange glow lights the burnt arm from below, a fiery rim light. Expression: a stubborn set jaw, a hot steady glare, a hard line to her mouth, daring the viewer to flinch.

people.imagined: In the stable at night, practising the Nest's splice on a spare reel by lamplight, scarf of fire-silk knotted at his neck; caught, he laughs easily to cover it, charming and slightly off.
people.subject: The moment: in a stable at night he holds a small reel of orange-red silk thread with a half-made splice and smiles with easy charm at the viewer, caught, a shade too quick with the grin. Face: a handsome, open, easy face of about thirty-six, high cheekbones, straight nose, a warm wide mouth, soft brown eyes crinkled and a little sheepish, fine well-shaped brows, a bit of stubble, a small dimple in the chin. Hair: glossy black, tied half up with a silver pin. Body: tall, loose, graceful, leaning against a stall post with one ankle crossed over the other. Clothing: fine layered vermilion silk with crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves rolled to the forearm, a gold-bordered dark-red sash with jade, a travelling cape of sheer red gauze over one shoulder, and a scarf of fire-silk of an odd, slightly wrong orange, not quite the palace's vermilion, knotted loosely at his throat. Hands and objects: a wooden reel wound with orange-red silk thread and a fine needle; a lantern on a hook. Power: warm ember-orange motes and green leaf-light drift lazily around his hands and the thread, faint. Background: dark wooden stalls in soft mist, a chestnut horse's head over a half-door, a cart loaded with silk reels in cloth. Light: warm lantern gold from the upper left picks out the silver pin and the scarf, a gentle glowing rim. Expression: an easy, charming grin, a guilty flick of the glance to one side.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Rites, rehearsal. A door creaks and he tilts his head toward it, ears first, as if it were a note, flute lowered.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a bare music hall, he tilts his head sharply toward a sound at the side door and holds still, flute lowered. Face: a long, pale, quiet face of about forty, the head cocked at a steep angle with one ear lifted toward the sound, eyes distant and unfocused, a long nose, thin lips parted slightly, fine dark brows, slightly large ears set a little forward, fine lines at the temples. Hair: black, in a low tied knot with a slim jade pin, one loose lock beside his left ear. Body: slim, seated with a straight back. Clothing: flowing vermilion silk in layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, long wide sleeves that pool on the floor, borders of gold feathers and green leaf thread, a dark-red sash with a green jade pendant. Hands and objects: a long dark bamboo flute held loosely across his knee, slender hands. Power: faint ripples of green qi and drifting red motes spread from the flute as if sound had a colour. Background: a row of red-lacquered pillars receding into a dim hall in mist, a zither on a stand, a low table with a second flute on a silk cloth, a screen painted with a single bird in flight. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, shadowless, and a thin ray of sun draws a bright line along the flute. Expression: faraway eyes, a listening stillness, the whole face given to the sound.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Virtue's copy room, late. He has two stacks, one copy and a second, and looks up with careful blankness at someone entering.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk in a copy room late at night, he hides a second copy of a letter under a stack and looks up with a careful, blank face, one eye straying toward the hidden page. Face: a narrow, pinched, sallow face of about forty-five, a thin hooked nose, small suspicious eyes beneath thin brows that meet in a frown, a tight small mouth, deep vertical creases in the forehead, a small ink spot on the chin. Hair: grey-black, thin, scraped back in a tiny knot with a plain bone pin. Body: thin, hunched, elbows in, covering the desk like a man guarding a hoard. Clothing: vermilion silk robes in layers, crossed collars of cream and dark red, sleeves tied back with a gold cord, borders of gold thread, a dark-red sash with a small red jade. Hands and objects: a fine brush in the right hand, ink to the second knuckle on both hands, black and glossy; two near-identical stacks of paper tied with red cord. Power: a faint ember-red glow collects on the brush tip and a few dim sparks drift off the paper. Background: a shelf of scrolls in neat rows in soft mist, a lamp, a brush stand and an ink stone. Light: a lamp from the upper left casts a small bright pool on his hands and leaves his face half in shadow, a thin cool rim light. Expression: a careful blank look, small suspicious eyes, a tight mouth and not a flicker of feeling.

people.imagined: At the furnace at Chu Sa Tuyền, tasting a pill her master cannot taste. She wets a fingertip, yellow with turmeric, and lifts it to her tongue and thinks.
people.subject: The moment: standing at an alchemy furnace, she tastes a pinch of yellow powder from a fingertip and considers it, head cocked, the whole round body concentrated on the taste. Face: a round, friendly face of about thirty, a snub nose, warm brown eyes half closed in concentration and slightly red from steam, rosy cheeks, a pale line of sweat on the upper lip, fingertips and nails stained bright saffron yellow to the quick held to her lips. Hair: black, in a bun tied with a cream silk ribbon and a small jade pin. Body: short, sturdy, a little round, her weight on one foot. Clothing: vermilion silk robes in layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves tied back with a gold cord, a cream silk over-sash stained with spice, a dark-red sash with a red jade pendant and a small gold flame border at the hem. Hands and objects: a small pinch of yellow powder on the fingertip; behind her a squat bronze furnace the size of a barrel glowing with orange coals, pots of spices. Power: warm orange-gold wisps of qi curl from the furnace and a few glowing green motes of herb-light drift round her hands. Background: shelves of clay pots daubed with coloured paint in drifting steam, dried herb bunches from the beams, a window onto green jungle. Light: warm orange furnace light plays on her left cheek and the yellow fingertip from the lower left, a soft rim light. Expression: half-closed eyes, brows drawn a little together, the friendly face quiet, weighing the taste.

people.imagined: On a jetty at Thạch Cơ, a knot he has just tied slips. He rubs the old rope scar round his wrist without looking and re-ties it, patient, accepting that nothing he mends stays mended.
people.subject: The moment: on a wooden jetty, he rubs a rope scar on his wrist with his thumb and looks up with quiet resignation, a slipped knot in the other hand, knowing nothing he mends stays mended. Face: a weathered, lean face of about forty-five, a square jaw, a short salt-grey beard, steady dark eyes with deep wrinkles fanning from the corners, wind-chapped lips, a faded tattoo of a small blue wave on the side of his neck; a pale raised ring of rope scar circles his left wrist, held near his chest. Hair: black with grey, cropped short under a red silk headscarf, stray grey hairs fluttering in the sea wind. Body: wiry, sea-hardened. Clothing: a short vermilion silk jacket cut for the sea over layered cream inner robes, crossed collars, sleeves tied back, a dark sash with a jade toggle, a gold feather border at the hem, wide trousers rolled. Hands and objects: a length of wet rope with a loose knot hanging from the right hand. Power: faint blue wisps of water-qi curl about his wrist and the rope, with a few red motes, calm and low. Background: masts and rigging of two ships with furled red sails, a stack of barrels, a long grey jetty and a pale grey sea under a low sky with a lone gull, sea-mist rising. Light: pale pearly grey-gold sea light from the upper left with a warm gold edge on the rope. Expression: a resigned look, a small tired half-smile, a slack mouth.

people.imagined: On the deck at the end of a dive, hair wet, standing with the sabre hidden under a cloth and a story ready. He faces the viewer daring them to ask whose face he has.
people.subject: The moment: on a wet deck after a dive, he stands dripping, jaw out, and meets the viewer's eyes daring a question, a bundle with a sabre hilt hidden under his arm. Face: a homely, heavy-browed face of about thirty-three, a nose clearly broken, flattened and bent to one side, very heavy dark brows that meet nearly in a line, a thick jaw, a wide mouth with a lip split from the cold, small deep-set black eyes, a thick vein at the temple, cheeks nicked with small old scars, water running down it. Hair: black, wet and plastered, tied in a short tail. Body: thick-chested, strong swimmer's shoulders, chest heaving slowly. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket soaked dark red and clinging, open at the neck over cream inner robes, wide sleeves heavy with water, a gold-bordered sash, a small lead weight on a silk cord with a jade bead. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a cloth-wrapped long bundle under his arm, the hilt of a curved sabre showing at one end. Power: a cold blue aura of water-qi, beads of water hanging in the air around him, a few red motes at his sleeves. Background: wet planks of a deck with coiled lines, a mast in shadow, a dripping rail, the grey-green sea in mist running to a low horizon. Light: cold silver light slants from the upper left and glitters in the beads of water on his shoulders and brow. Expression: defiant, ambitious, concealed.

people.imagined: On the wall of the vein fort, he cannot stand still: he has just shifted post again and the glove on his left hand creaks, forearm pale as flour. He wants to be sent against the Tower.
people.subject: The moment: pacing a battlement, he stops abruptly and turns on the viewer with a hard glare, unable to stay still. Face: a hard, square face of about forty, a heavy jaw, a short nose, a thin hard mouth twisted, small angry black eyes, a cropped dark beard, a vein at the temple, a short white scar through the lower lip. Hair: black, cropped close and caught in a short knot with a steel-grey pin, a few grey bristles at the temples. Body: stocky, tense, on the balls of his feet, a hand twitching toward his belt. Clothing: a short vermilion silk jacket over layered robes, crossed collars of red and cream, wide sleeves with silver-grey borders, a dark-red sash, silvered cuffs; one hand in a thick black silk glove while the other forearm is bare below a rolled sleeve and floury pale, a stark difference. Hands and objects: a short red fan in the gloved hand. Power: a cold grey-silver glint of metal-qi on the glove and thin red sparks at his shoulders. Background: a wide stone battlement with crenellations and a banner pole with no flag, a pair of crows on the parapet, a brown valley falling away under cloud to a bruise-coloured sky. Light: hard white spirit-light from the upper left gives him two dark pits for eyes, a pale rim light. Expression: a hard glare, the thin mouth twisted, the jaw working, restless and cruel.

people.imagined: In the clerk's room an hour before the storm: his hair has lifted from his scalp and stands up around his head. He looks at the clear sky, impatient.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk with a rota in front of him an hour before a storm, his hair standing straight up in strands like a halo of static, he glares at the clear sky through a window. Face: a thin, sharp, restless face of about thirty-eight, a hooked nose, a clipped moustache whose hairs stand out from the lip, bristling brows, restless mistrustful eyes, a wry twist to the mouth, a thin line of sweat at the hairline, a small nick on the chin. Hair: black, standing on end. Body: thin, angular. Clothing: a clean robe of pale undyed silk in two layers, crossed collars of cream and grey, sleeves tied back with a red cord left half untied at the waist, one sleeve pulled up over a forearm with a tiny blue-white scar; the plainest graceful robe of an outer disciple. Hands and objects: a brush and a rota sheet; a small iron bell on the desk. Slung across his back, the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword rises past the left shoulder, its grip wrapped in undyed hemp tied off with a single red cord, a plain steel guard, a faint violet shimmer along the steel, the scabbard of dull dark wutong-wood. Power: a blue-white and violet static crackles in the hair and along the sword's hilt, tiny sparks leaping. Background: a plain wooden window framing a hard blue sky with no cloud, shelves of rolled rota sheets, a brass bell and a dish of cold tea. Light: bright white light from the window makes each upright hair a bright line, a faint violet rim. Expression: a sharp scowl at the window, thin lips pulled flat.

people.imagined: Climbing the long road to the Ridge of the Returning Feathers with a stack of urns on her back, slowly. She has stopped to rest and turns her head back along the road.
people.subject: The moment: climbing a long stone road, she stops and looks back at the viewer, walking slowly as if the urns on her back were still full. Face: a lined, gentle, pious face of about sixty-five, a high forehead, sunken cheeks, high cheekbones, skin the colour of old paper, kind deep-set eyes, a soft mouth with a faint smile of long habit. Hair: silver, in a plain low knot with a red cord and a gold feather pin. Body: thin, bent forward under the weight, small careful tread, knees slightly bent. Clothing: a robe of vermilion silk faded to coral in several layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves, a narrow red silk band tied across her forehead, dark-red sash, hem with two bands of gold and white, the richer robe of a steward of funerals. Hands and objects: a staff in the right hand; a stack of small grey ceramic urns bound to a wooden frame on her back, three or four visible above her shoulders; one red feather tucked in the frame. Power: a soft pale-gold glow around the urns and a few red embers drifting up like small lanterns. Background: a long flight of grey stone steps curving up a hill between dark wutong trees with drifting yellow leaves, a stone lantern at every tenth step, and at the top a tiny gate against a pale sky, evening mist. Light: soft golden evening light from the upper left lights the urns and the tired lines of her face. Expression: a quiet, a little distant look, the brow smooth.

people.imagined: In the aviary, an egg basket lined with down at his feet, stroking the red-crested skin purse at his belt while he explains how the hen died in the moult.
people.subject: The moment: standing among the perches of an aviary, he strokes a small red-feathered skin purse at his belt with one hand and speaks earnestly at the viewer. Face: a smooth, earnest, round face of about thirty-three, a neat nose, wide honest-looking brown eyes with a slightly too steady gaze, neat slightly raised brows, thin quick lips, a tiny scratch across the back of his right hand from a bird's claw. Hair: black, in a neat topknot with a green ribbon and a jade pin. Body: medium, neat, tall in posture, weight even. Clothing: vermilion silk robes in layers, crossed collars of cream and green, wide sleeves rolled, gold and green feather borders, a dark-red sash with a small silver bell, clean cuffs. Hands and objects: a small purse made of red-crested bird skin with bright red feathers, held and stroked by his thumb at the bottom of the frame; a basket of eggs lined with soft grey down on his arm. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood-qi and a few red feather-light motes around his hands. Background: aviary perches rising in tiers in soft mist, a red-crested bird asleep on each with its head under a wing, a doorway where a woman's silhouette watches. Light: pale diffuse spirit-light falls from a skylight and glints on the red feathers of the purse, a thin rim light. Expression: callous, earnest, false.

people.imagined: Laughing with her mouth closed at the sparring ground, the told letter not on her conscience; the stained chipped tooth is hidden behind the closed smile.
people.subject: The moment: at the sparring ground, she smiles with her lips tightly closed, eyes bright with mischief, barely holding back a laugh. Face: a round, bright, freckled face of about thirty-three, a button nose, quick brown eyes, flushed rosy cheeks, a small pale scar on the chin; the closed-lip smile stretches wide with a hint of a stained, chipped front tooth showing at one corner. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a red cord and a small gold flame pin, a few loose strands stuck to her damp neck. Body: sturdy, quick, springy, feet apart and weight forward, shoulders loose. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket in layers over cream, crossed collars of cream and flame, sleeves rolled up, gold phoenix-flame borders, a dark-red sash with a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a red fan held in the right hand. Power: a few playful red sparks and a haze of warm orange qi rise from her shoulders. Background: the packed earth of a sparring yard in soft mist, a rack of practice fans, a few disciples in red robes sparring in the distance, a high wall with a tiled roof. Light: bright daylight from the upper left, golden, with a glowing rim light that makes her lips look dark against her teeth. Expression: a wide closed-lip grin, eyes glinting with mischief, cheeks flushed.

people.imagined: In the sick-hall at Hoàng Vân Thành, bending over a bed, bundles of lavender hung overhead; the scent reaches the room before she does.
people.subject: The moment: in a sick-hall she bends gently forward from the waist with one hand on her knee and looks up with a soft smile, a sprig of lavender raised near her face. Face: a gentle, round, pale face of about forty-two, soft cheeks, kind dark eyes with fine laugh lines and a shadow of fatigue under each, a small sweet mouth, a few grey strands in the hairline. Hair: black, in a low loose knot with a few lavender buds and a jade pin. Body: soft, rounded, a slight stoop from long years of leaning over beds. Clothing: flowing vermilion silk in layers, crossed collars of cream and white, sleeves tied back with a cord, a white silk over-sash, a dark-red sash with a green jade pendant, gold and green borders. Hands and objects: a sprig of purple lavender in the right hand, bright violet against the red robe; a small clay jar of salve in the left. Power: a soft green and pale-blue healing light gathers around her hands and the lavender, tiny motes drifting down toward the bed. Background: a long hall of low beds with white sheets, a patient asleep in the nearest, bundles of dried lavender hanging from the beams, an open window onto a green rice field, mist. Light: soft clear spirit-light from the window falls across the sheets and makes the lavender almost luminous, from the upper left. Expression: a soft, kind smile, her gaze low and gentle, brows lifted slightly in care.

people.imagined: In the granary at Hoàng Vân Thành, reading chalk tallies from his sleeve aloud to himself; a sack stands slightly open behind him.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a granary aisle, he reads chalk tally marks down his sleeve aloud, lips moving, then glances up. Face: a plump, careful, round face of about forty-eight, small shrewd eyes with yellowish whites, a pursed mouth, a neat grey-black moustache, a slight double chin, fine rice-dust powdering the brows and moustache. Hair: black going grey, in a topknot with a red cord and a gold pin, thin on top and combed carefully across. Body: stout, upright, hands folded. Clothing: a robe of good vermilion silk in layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves, a dark-red sash with a red jade pendant, gold borders; the left sleeve carries a long column of white chalk tally marks running down its whole length from shoulder to cuff, bold and plain. Hands and objects: a stick of white chalk in the right hand; a string of keys and a small abacus of jade beads hanging from the sash. Power: a soft ochre-gold glow of earth-qi and a few warm red motes dust the air around him. Background: tall pyramids of grain sacks tied with rope run down a long hall in mist, grain dust floating in shafts of light from high windows, a small boy half visible sweeping at the far end. Light: warm dusty gold spirit-light slants from the high windows on the upper left and edges the sacks. Expression: a pursed, self-satisfied mouth, small shrewd eyes flicking up over the tallies, his chin lifted a little in pleasure at the count.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Spoils among racks of captured arms, the red sword wrapped in cloth beside him. He dusts it as he has for seventy years, a cloth in his fist.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim hall, he gently dusts a cloth-wrapped long object, then looks up at the viewer with pale, cautious eyes. Face: a very pale, almost grey, bloodless face of about forty-five from seventy years without sun, deep blue-grey shadows under the eyes, a thin nose, thin bloodless lips, knuckles reddened by constant rubbing. Hair: black, thin, combed tight and flat against the skull, in a small knot with a slim silver pin. Body: thin, stooped, narrow. Clothing: a plain, dust-free vermilion silk robe in layers, crossed collars of cream and red, sleeves tied back with cord above the wrist, a dark-red sash, gold borders, a string of three tiny brass keys round his neck, soft silent slippers. Hands and objects: a pale dust cloth gripped in his right fist at his chest; with his left hand he touches a long bundle wrapped in red cloth on a rack, a plum-blossom shaped guard just visible at one end. Power: the red cloth gives off a faint ember-red glow and a thin thread of crimson qi rises from the bundle and curls toward his hand. Background: rows of weapon racks in a dim hall of mist, spears with banners of captured cloth, a dented helm, a shelf of curved swords, and on the central rack the long red bundle with a small lamp burning before it. Light: a dim grey spirit-light from a high window on the upper left, and a faint orange glow from the lamp on the red cloth. Expression: a pale, careful face with lowered grey eyes and tight lips, wary and honest, his glance fixed on the wrapped blade.

people.imagined: At the Tang Điền silk market, counting out a price with a smile; a silk cuff drawn over the stump of a missing finger, rings on the rest.
people.subject: The moment: at a market stall, he gestures with one open hand, rings glinting, smiling a salesman's smile, having already decided the price. Face: a plump, smooth, shrewd face of about forty, a waxed thin moustache curled into two points, quick bright black eyes, a sleek smile with a gold tooth glint, deep lines from nose to mouth corners, a small jade stud in each ear; a silk cuff pulled neatly over a missing finger, the hand shown with a gap and rings gleaming on the other three fingers and thumb. Hair: black, oiled, in a neat topknot with a gold pin. Body: round, well-fed, leaning back on his heels with his belly out. Clothing: a rich vermilion silk robe in three layers, crossed collars embroidered with fine gold thread, wide sleeves, a dark-red brocade sash with a red jade and gold coin pendant, a pouch. Hands and objects: a bolt of orange-red silk over his arm; one hand showing the rings. Power: a faint gold-orange shimmer plays round the rings and the silk. Background: a market of silk bolts and bright orange and red awnings in warm haze, a weaver with an angry face half hidden behind a loom, rolls of cloth on a cart, a harbour crane at the end of the street. Light: bright warm spirit-light from the upper left glitters on his rings and picks out the gold thread at the collar. Expression: greedy, smooth, slippery.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Righteousness at night, spreading war maps under a lamp. The black armband on his upper arm is worn to threads; his eyes follow the border road.
people.subject: The moment: standing over a map table at night, one hand resting on the map, he looks up hard at the viewer, his eyes following the border road. Face: a hard, tanned, lean face of about forty-five, a square jaw, deep lines and a deep furrow between the brows, burning dark eyes red-rimmed from long nights, a short black beard, a white scar across the chin. Hair: black, cropped short, with a grey streak, in a knot with a gold pin. Body: tall, straight, a soldier's carriage, leaning with his weight on his left hand. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe cut for riding in layers, crossed collars of flame and cream, silver-edged bracers, a dark-red sash, gold and white borders; a black cloth armband tied round the upper left arm with a tight double knot, its edge worn to a soft fringe of threads, bold black against the red sleeve. Hands and objects: a closed red fan in the right hand pointing at a map of mountains; on the table a bronze lamp, a bowl of cold tea and a pile of rolled maps. Power: a strong red aura of flame rises behind him and sparks gather at the fan's tip, his shadow flaring huge on the wall. Background: a hall in dark mist, the map of mountains in brown ink with small red markers along a border, behind him in the dark a rack of red fans. Light: a lamp from the lower left lights his face from below, a fiery rim light on his shoulder. Expression: a grim, burning stare, a locked jaw, lines pulled deep beside the mouth, old patient anger.

people.imagined: Beside the Ash Seat at the Nest, handing a water bowl to someone who will go further than she did. She watches the censer smoke.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a stone seat and a smoking censer, she offers a bowl of water with a gentle bow of her head, patient and humble. Face: a calm, pale, lined, kind face of about fifty-five, grey eyes, a small mouth with a faint kind smile, one eyebrow burned away completely leaving a bare, smooth, slightly shiny pale ridge on the left, the other thin brow intact, a faint smoke-stain on the forehead, a thin line of soot at the hairline, pale lips cracked from the heat. Hair: grey, in a low knot with a red cord and a small gold pin. Body: slim, upright, feet together, back straight in a servant's patient courtesy. Clothing: vermilion silk robes in layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves tied back, a dark-red sash with a small jade, gold and white borders, a grey ash smear on the cuff and ash-dusted sleeve edges, thick cork-soled slippers. Hands and objects: a plain pottery bowl of clear water held out in both hands; at her side a seat of rough black stone and a bronze censer with grey smoke on a tripod. Power: a thin red heat-shimmer and drifting embers rise around her, a faint warm aura. Background: a dark cavern in mist, a heap of grey ash raked into rings, the red glow of the vent far below. Light: orange glow from the lower right lights the jaw and the bare ridge where the brow was burned, cool spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: calm and humble, the face tilted in a small bow, the bare brow lifted slightly.

people.imagined: In the Nest array room, a strand of warm new silk held up to the light between two fingers. She frowns, suspicious.
people.subject: The moment: standing on tiptoe, she holds a strand of warm new silk up to the light between thumb and finger and squints at it, suspicious. Face: a thin, sharp, sallow face of about thirty-two, hollow cheeks, a narrow nose, a faint white scar across the upper lip, dark alert eyes with the whites showing a little around the iris, a tight mouth; dozens of fine hair-thin red cuts hatch all her fingertips on the raised hand. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a wooden pin and a silver thread ribbon. Body: wiry, forward-leaning, her thin body drawn tight like a thread. Clothing: vermilion silk robes in layers, crossed collars of cream and flame, sleeves tied back and pinned, tiny orange threads clinging to the gauze, a dark-red sash, a strip of cloth wound round the right wrist, a thin silver thimble on one finger, gold borders. Hands and objects: a strand of orange-gold silk glowing faintly between thumb and finger; before her an array of red silk threads stretched in a lattice. Power: strong waves of red-orange qi run along the threads, which hum and glimmer like strings of light. Background: a room full of taut glowing silk thread strung wall to wall, row on row, with a single strand of a different, brighter orange among them and a ladder leaning against the frame, in soft mist. Light: warm orange glow from the threads lights her from every side with no shadows except under her chin. Expression: a narrow, suspicious squint, thin mouth tight, brow drawn down, dark eyes sharp and not trusting.

people.imagined: After a joke has been told, he waits a beat, then smiles carefully as if checking it is safe. He passed the Kindling at ninety-two and is still not quite sure.
people.subject: The moment: a beat after a joke, he smiles slowly and carefully, his eyes checking the viewer's face first to see if it is safe. Face: a very old, round, soft, deeply lined face of about eighty-five, a slow, delayed smile only now beginning, watery pale-brown eyes with white lashes, sparse white brows, a wispy white beard with a few long hairs on the chin, round pink cheeks spotted with age marks. Hair: white and thin, in a small topknot with a bamboo-green cord. Body: round, frail, a bit stooped, sitting with his back bent, leaning slightly forward as if still waiting for the verdict. Clothing: a clean, well-fitted vermilion silk robe in layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves, a single gold border, a dark-red sash tied with a bamboo-green cord, a small bamboo whistle hanging at his throat. Hands and objects: a folded red fan held neatly in both hands at his chest. Power: a soft green-gold glow of wood-qi like new leaves hovers round his white hair as a halo, a few green motes drifting. Background: a courtyard of beaten earth with a row of bamboo pots, a tall clump of green bamboo in morning mist, a low wall with a tiled roof, a few young disciples laughing in the distance. Light: warm morning spirit-light from the upper left lights his white hair, a gentle rim light. Expression: a slow, careful smile arriving late on the old round face, watery eyes checking whether it is safe.

people.imagined: At the top of the ridge stair in cold wind, he looks down at someone who has climbed it, deciding by whim whether to let them up; the plum scar on his nose has gone white.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the top of a long stone stair in cold wind, he looks down at the viewer and decides, by whim, whether to let them up. Face: a heavy, square, stubborn face of about forty-five, a broad jaw, small hard grey eyes, a thick neck, a flat set mouth, thick brows meeting over the nose, windburnt dark-red skin, short grey stubble, a plum-shaped scar across the bridge of the nose gone white. Hair: black, cropped, in a short knot with a steel pin. Body: broad, heavy, planted, thumbs hooked in his belt. Clothing: a vermilion silk jacket in layers cut for the guard, crossed collars of flame and cream, wide sleeves with silver-grey and gold borders, a dark-red sash with a smooth bronze-gold buckle, a red silk cloth tied round his upper arm, a short breastplate of lacquered red scales over the robe, the dress of a guard captain. Hands and objects: a red fan held closed at his side like a baton. Power: a cold grey-silver aura of metal-qi with a few red sparks, his robe lifting in the wind. Background: a long flight of grey steps worn in the middle dropping away below him, a stone gate with a crooked roof at the top, the dark shapes of enormous wutong trees on both sides, mist. Light: thin grey spirit-light from the upper left makes the white scar on his nose glow, a cold rim light. Expression: a heavy, flat look down the stair from small hard eyes, the jaw set and the mouth idle, as if he has not yet decided.

people.imagined: Arriving at a vassal hall, she is re-tying her sash in the host's colour as she greets them with a warm smile.
people.subject: The moment: at a doorway, she ties a sash into a new knot in the host's colour and smiles warmly at the viewer. Face: a warm, wide, rosy face of about thirty-eight, a ready generous smile with dimples, lively brown eyes, soft arched brows, long lashes, lips painted a soft wine red, a tiny gold stud in her left nostril. Hair: black, in an elaborate double bun with a red lacquer comb and gold phoenix hairpins. Body: medium, graceful, easy, weight on one hip, head tilted. Clothing: vermilion silk robes in three layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, wide sleeves, gold and white borders, a short sheer pale-gold cape over one shoulder, a small satchel of red brocade at her hip. Hands and objects: both hands lifted with a bold wine-red thread sash being re-tied; a small clay wine jar swinging from a red cord at her wrist. Power: a warm red-gold glow and a few drifting sparks and blue motes, the easy aura of a guest who is welcome anywhere. Background: a wooden gateway hung with paper lanterns in different colours, a servant in a doorway holding a tray, a courtyard with a stone table and cups, soft mist. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left makes the wine-red sash glow, a soft rim light. Expression: a warm, wide smile with dimples, lively eyes meeting the host's, her shrewd glance moving quickly over the room.

people.imagined: In the outer court at dawn, bending over a pot of wutong sapling, whispering to it; her fingernails green; she looks up, a leaf quivering toward her.
people.subject: The moment: bending over a potted wutong sapling at dawn, whispering to it, she looks up at the viewer with a gentle, open smile as a leaf quivers toward her. Face: a round, soft, rosy face of about eighteen, a small nose, large calm dark-brown eyes, plump freckled cheeks with a small dimple, thick lashes, a tiny smear of earth on the chin; green under every fingernail, moss-green crescents on both hands cupped around the sapling. Hair: black, in two low braids tied with green silk thread, a leaf stuck above the left ear. Body: small, sturdy, bending forward, shoulders soft and round. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of a young outer disciple, pale undyed cream silk in two layers with crossed collars, wide sleeves rolled up, a single red cord at the waist, a narrow green leaf border at the hem, a straw hat hung on her back by a silk cord. Hands and objects: a small clay pot with a sapling of broad wutong leaves, one leaf tilted toward her. Power: soft green wisps of wood-qi and glowing leaf-motes rise from the sapling toward her face, unmistakably more than a young girl should draw. Background: rows of clay pots with young wutong saplings in an outer court in dawn mist, a stone wall, a tall tree whose big leaves are all slightly turned toward her. Light: soft dawn gold from the upper left lights her round face, a gentle glowing rim light. Expression: a gentle, open smile, large calm eyes lowered tenderly toward the sapling, quietly content.

people.imagined: At the roadside, hat pushed back in the sun, counting the paddy by eye with a lazy half-smile, not seeing the strip she is about to rule on.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a field edge with a rice-straw hat pushed far back, she surveys the viewer sleepily and with satisfaction, counting the paddy by eye. Face: a round, tanned, calm face of about twenty, sleepy half-lidded eyes, a wide mouth, a small snub nose, sunburnt freckled cheeks, thin straight brows, a small mole under the left eye, a little yawn at the corner of her mouth. Hair: black, in one loose braid with a green ribbon; the hat brim a halo round her head, bright and obvious. Body: sturdy, comfortable, one hip cocked and arms hanging loose, never in a hurry. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of an outer disciple, pale cream silk tied with a red cord, two crossed collars, sleeves rolled back, a narrow green border, a strip of old blue silk tied round her left wrist, the hem faintly muddy from the paddy dyke, bare feet stained green to the ankle. Hands and objects: a stalk of rice in her hand. Power: only a hint, a few pale green motes drifting above the paddy near her. Background: a patchwork of square paddies shimmering in the sun, a farmer bending in the far corner, a mud track, a low line of green hills in mist and a small village of thatched roofs. Light: bright soft light from the upper left flashes off the wet paddy and the hat's brim. Expression: sleepy, half-lidded eyes and a lazy, satisfied half-smile, slack relaxed cheeks.

people.imagined: At the fan-makers' forge with his sleeve rolled, a spark just leapt; he looks at the new burn freckles on his arm with pride.
people.subject: The moment: at a small fan-makers' forge, he holds up a forearm freckled with tiny burn marks and grins stubbornly, proud of the new burn from a spark. Face: a broad, stubborn, square face of about twenty-four, a strong chin, thick brows singed short on one side, a short nose, bright eyes, black soot smudges on the cheek and across the bridge of the nose, a lower lip jutting in stubbornness; hundreds of tiny dark pink and brown forge-burn spots cover the whole right forearm held up, plain and dense. Hair: black, cropped, the front singed to a frizz. Body: stocky, strong, one foot forward and shoulders back like a boy showing a prize. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of an outer disciple, pale cream silk with crossed collars and a red cord at the waist, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder over heavy forearms, a narrow grey and red border, a small scorch hole near the hem. Hands and objects: iron tongs holding a glowing strip of metal. Power: a faint grey-silver and red glint of metal and flame-qi on the strip, sparks drifting up like small stars. Background: an open-fronted forge with a brick hearth in warm haze, bellows, rows of half-finished iron fan ribs hung on hooks, a pale heap of feathers on a bench. Light: deep orange hearth glow from the lower right on his arm and chin, blue-white spirit-light in the doorway, a hot rim light. Expression: a stubborn, proud grin with the chin out, bright eyes, brows pulled down, eager for the next spark.

people.imagined: On the stair, copying his mentor's stance with her head tilt exaggerated half an inch too far, arrogant at being seen.
people.subject: The moment: on a stair he strikes a posed fan stance copied from his mentor, with his head tilted half an inch too far and a smirk, arrogant at being watched. Face: a young, handsome, arrogant face of about twenty-two, a sharp nose, narrow bright dark eyes, a curled lower lip, a streak of ash on the cheek, a thin line of ash like eyeliner darkening the lids, the chin pointing at a too-sharp angle. Hair: black, in a high knot with a gold pin, one long lock hanging. Body: lean, stiff in the pose, one leg bent and the chest thrust out. Clothing: a well-fitted vermilion silk robe in layers, crossed collars of flame and cream, wide sleeves with gold flame borders and a narrow black border at the collar, a dark-red sash tied in the same intricate knot as his mentor's, a tassel of red silk and a small red jade. Hands and objects: a red feather fan held in the lifted right hand with a tassel hanging from it. Power: a few bright red sparks and a thin haze of flame-qi follow the fan's sweep, young and showy. Background: a long stair of red stone climbs behind him in mist, a row of disciples on the lower steps watching with open mouths, and at the top a tall woman with red hair, out of focus. Light: bright warm spirit-light from the upper left throws his shadow in a long angular shape across the steps, a glowing rim light. Expression: a curled-lip smirk with the chin pointed, narrow eyes half lowered, staged and pleased with himself.

people.imagined: At dawn on the gate step, flute at her lips, mouth in a shape even when not playing; she plays the morning when the old man's breath is short.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a gate step, she stands holding a flute lowered, her lips still shaped in a small round embouchure, looking at the viewer. Face: a calm, narrow, pale face of about twenty-six, a straight nose, steady eyes, serene brows, thin lips held pursed in a clear small ring of mouth with a faint crease at each side, clear skin, long lashes. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot with a red pin and a small gold phoenix hairpin. Body: slim, straight, her weight over both feet and shoulders open, the breathing posture of a player. Clothing: vermilion silk robes in layers, crossed collars of cream and gold, long sleeves in clean folds with gold feather borders, a dark-red sash, a plain wooden flute case hanging from it by a cord with a small jade tassel, the collar closed with a small coral button. Hands and objects: a pale bamboo flute held in both hands at the chest, smooth along the finger stops. Power: faint rosy-gold ripples of qi and a few red motes spread from the flute like the echo of a note. Background: a grey stone gate with two red-lacquered doors half open, a courtyard of damp flagstones still in shadow and rose mist, an old man's bent figure in the doorway. Light: pink dawn light from the upper left, a rose glow on the roof tiles while she stands in cool blue shade, a soft rim light. Expression: calm and serene, steady eyes, a smooth quiet brow.

people.imagined: In the outer court, a fresh yellow chrysanthemum behind her ear, bounding forward with a cousin's brag on her lips.
people.subject: The moment: striding forward cheerfully in the outer court, a fresh yellow chrysanthemum tucked behind her ear, she grins at the viewer with a cousin's brag on her lips. Face: a round, freckled, open face of about seventeen, a gap-toothed grin, bright brown eyes, rosy cheeks, thick straight brows, a nose dusted with freckles. Hair: black, in a long loose ponytail, a fresh bright yellow chrysanthemum with many petals behind the right ear, big and clear. Body: small, springy, chest out and chin up, swinging her free arm. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of a young outer disciple, pale cream silk with a crossed collar and a red cord at the waist, sleeves rolled unevenly, a narrow gold chrysanthemum border, a string of dried yellow chrysanthemum heads hung round her neck like a necklace, plain silk slippers. Hands and objects: a bundle of dried chrysanthemum stalks in her arms. Power: only a hint, a few small warm sparks and golden petal-motes drifting around her. Background: a whitewashed wall lined with pots of yellow and white chrysanthemums, a tiled gateway with a small bell, a path of raked gravel, soft mist. Light: bright warm spirit-light from the upper left makes the yellow petals glow, a gentle rim light. Expression: a wide gap-toothed grin, bright eyes and rosy cheeks, bold and open, ready to talk.

people.imagined: On the Thạch Cơ jetty mending nets in the sun; his eyebrows bleached white, a calm half-smile, in no hurry.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a jetty mending a net in the sun, he glances up calmly at the viewer, in no hurry. Face: a broad, relaxed, deep-brown tanned face of about thirty, sun-bleached eyebrows and eyelashes almost pure white in striking contrast, a flat nose, easy dark eyes with a thin line of salt at the corners, chapped pale lips, a lazy smile. Hair: sun-streaked brown, in a short tail tied with a dark cord. Body: lean, brown, slouched, knees apart and shoulders slumped with the net heaped over his legs. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of an outer disciple, pale cream silk jacket with a crossed collar, a red cord at the waist faded to pink, sleeves cut short at the elbow, a narrow blue border, a bone toggle at the front, wide trousers rolled, bare feet. Hands and objects: a fishing net across his knees and a netting needle. Power: faint blue ripples of water-qi curl around the net and his hands, a few pale motes. Background: weathered planks of a jetty, a row of small fishing boats tied up, a heap of orange floats, gulls on a post, a green-grey sea with a pale distant island in sea-mist. Light: bright sun low on the water from the upper left throws a dazzling shimmer up under his chin, a glowing rim light. Expression: a calm, easy half-smile, relaxed lids, an unhurried lazy look from under the white brows.

people.imagined: In the outer court, his left sleeve twitching on its own; a small snout pokes from the cuff; he stands blank and steady.
people.subject: The moment: standing flat-footed in a courtyard, his left sleeve moving as a small fox snout pokes out at the cuff, he looks at the viewer blankly and steady. Face: a slow, wide, flat, tanned face of about thirty-two, small deep-set eyes set far apart under a heavy brow, a dull stare, thick cracked lips, a faint scar through the left eyebrow; at the front of the frame a small pointed fox snout with a wet black nose and bright eyes pokes out of the sleeve cuff. Hair: black, coarse, in a rough tail with a bone pin. Body: heavy, broad, still, arms slightly out and head lowered a little. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of an outer disciple, pale cream silk with crossed collars, a red cord at the waist, wide sleeves, a narrow green border, the sleeve that holds the fox cinched at the wrist with a silk strap, a tiger-claw charm on a cord round his neck. Hands and objects: the sleeve bulging; his right hand holds a short bow. Power: soft green wood-qi and a few glowing motes drift round the fox, gentle and low. Background: a courtyard wall with a heavy door, a hanging cage with a single bird, the dark green of a jungle hillside rising above the roof in mist. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle rim glow. Expression: a flat, blank stare, slack features, as untroubled as a stone while the fox snout twitches.

people.imagined: At the feather-sorting table, down clinging to her hair, turning her head away as a bird is carried past.
people.subject: The moment: at a table of feathers, she turns her face away from a bird carried past, wincing, one hand at her throat. Face: a soft, round, pale face of about twenty-five, a small nose, tender dark eyes with long damp lashes, a trembling pale mouth, soft white down clinging to her eyelashes, hair and cheek, plainly visible. Hair: black, in a loose bun flecked with feather down and held by a small plum-blossom pin. Body: soft, slight, shoulders curled inward, knees together. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of an outer disciple, pale cream silk with crossed collars, a red cord at the waist, sleeves tied back and dusted with soft white fluff, a shawl of woven feather-down in white folded over her shoulders, a narrow plum-pink border, a small silk purse of coins at the sash. Hands and objects: a handful of bright feathers. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood-qi and a few floating white motes mingle with the drifting down. Background: a long table heaped with feathers sorted by colour in baskets, red, white, brown and blue, a boy at the far end plucking a bird out of sight, a window with a view of plum trees in mist. Light: soft pale spirit-light from the window fills the scene with floating down, a gentle rim light. Expression: a pained wince with her face turned away, damp lashes lowered, her lower lip trembling.

people.imagined: At the copyist's desk, one sleeve ink-black, the other white, noticing something about the paper and looking suspiciously over her shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: at a copyist's desk with her brush raised, she looks suspiciously over her shoulder at the viewer, as if she has heard a noise. Face: a thin, pale, tight face of about thirty-five, a pointed nose, narrow watchful dark eyes, a firmly closed mouth with a faint line of ink on the upper lip, sunken cheeks. Hair: black, in a plain bun with a wooden pin and a red cord. Body: thin, huddled, twisted at the waist with one hand still on the desk. Clothing: the simplest graceful robe of an outer disciple, pale cream silk with crossed collars and a red cord at the waist, mismatched sleeves, the left one black with ink from wrist to elbow, the right one clean bright white and unmarked, a plain sash, a small brass key on a cord round her neck. Hands and objects: a brush and a sheet of ruled music paper. Power: a few small ember-red motes and a thin dark haze of ink-qi drift off the brush, faint. Background: a desk crowded with ink-stones and sheets of copied music, shelves of rolled scores rising behind her in mist, a half-open door with a strip of dim corridor. Light: a lamp from the upper left lights one side of her face in gold while the other side stays in shadow, a thin rim light. Expression: a tight, narrow-eyed glance over the shoulder, thin lips sealed, brows pinched in watchful suspicion.
